name: DeepTutor
one_liner: A free AI tutoring platform that builds a personalized learning path from your own documents and videos, tracks what you've learned, and quizzes you over time like a real tutor would.
buyer: A tutoring center owner or independent test-prep tutor who wants to offer personalized, trackable study plans without hiring extra tutors for every student.
business_use_cases: An independent test-prep tutor uploads a student's course materials and lets it generate a personalized learning path and spaced-repetition quizzes between sessions.
A small online course creator self-hosts it to give paying students a 'study companion' that tracks their progress through the course materials.
A corporate L&D team uses it to turn internal training PDFs into self-paced, quizzed learning tracks instead of building custom e-learning software.

money_ideas.idea: Self-host it and offer a branded 'AI study companion' as a premium add-on to existing tutoring or course packages.
Charge a setup fee to configure it with a client's own course materials and learning paths.

steal_this: Load one of your own course's materials into it this weekend and offer a free 'AI study buddy' trial to your existing students to justify a premium tier.
